Commentary.Commentary: We're back! Babar Azam and Saim Ayub are the openers. Jacob Duffy has the new ball in hand.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Pakistan will be confident to chase this down. This is a par score on this pitch, Pakistan have a long tail who can bat so, New Zealand have to be on top with the ball. Apart from Wasim, all of them chipped in with a wicket atleast. Abbas Afridi was the pick of all as he ended with three wickets. Overall, a fantastic performance from the home team and they'll back their batting unit to chase this down. JOin us shortly for the second half.

A brilliant performance from Pakistan as they have pulled things back in last few overs. New Zealand batted well throughout the innings mostly. Tim Robinson and Tom Blundell started really well. The former scored a fine fifty while Blundell and Dean Foxcroft played a handy innings. New Zealand though last the track as wickets kept falling regularly and none of their big hitters, Mark Chapman, James Neesham and Michael Bracewell performed with the bat.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Tom Blundell(WK), Tim Robinson, Dean Foxcroft, Mark Chapman, James Neesham, Michael Bracewell(C), Josh Clarkson, Ish Sodhi, Jacob Duffy, Ben Sears, William O'Rourke.
Pakistan (Playing XI) - Babar Azam(C), Saim Ayub, Usman Khan(WK), Fakhar Zaman, Iftikhar Ahmed, Shadab Khan, Imad Wasim, Usama Mir, Abbas Afridi, Mohammad Amir, Zaman Khan.
TOSS - PAKISTAN HAVE WON THE TOSS AND ELECTED TO BOWL!

It is time for the 4th T20I between Pakistan and New Zealand. It was rain which came out on top in the first one, Pakistan won the second quite comfortable. New Zealand though bounced back strongly and it was yet again Mark Chapman who haunted the hosts to help his side level the series. The team which wins this game will take an unassailable lead in the series. Can Pakistan bounce back or will the Kiwis spring in another surprise?
... MATCH DAY ...
